thought_title: Honor the Bishop; God Will Reward You

edition.witness_note: Lake 1912 Loeb copy-text; Lightfoot/Funk middle recension not yet locked as second witness

source_text: [1] Εὔλογόν ἐστιν λοιπὸν ἀνανῆψαι ἡμᾶς, ὡς ἔτι καιρὸν ἔχομεν εἰς θεὸν μετανοεῖν. καλῶς ἔχει, θεὸν καὶ ἐπίσκοπον εἰδέναι. ὁ τιμῶν ἐπίσκοπον ὑπὸ θεοῦ τετίμηται: ὁ λάθρα ἐπισκόπου τι πράσσων τῷ διαβόλῳ λατρεύει. [2] πάντα οὖν ὑμῖν ἐν χάριτι περισσευέτω: ἄξιοι γάρ ἐστε. κατὰ πάντα με ἀνεπαύσατε, καὶ ὑμᾶς Ἰησοῦς Χριστός. ἀπόντα με καὶ πάροντα ἠγαπήσατε. ἀμοιβὴ ὑμῖν ὁ θεός, δἰ ὃν πάντα ὑπομένοντες αὐτοῦ τεύξεσθε.
pass_a_gloss: [1] It is reasonable, from now on, for us to come back to our senses, while we still have time to repent toward God. It is good to know God and the bishop. The one who honors the bishop has been honored by God; the one who does anything behind the bishop's back serves the devil. [2] So let everything abound for you in grace, for you are worthy. In every way you refreshed me, and may Jesus Christ refresh you. Absent and present you loved me. God is your reward; enduring all things for his sake, you will reach him.

lemmas.gloss: become sober again, come to one's senses

pass_b_english: It is reasonable, from now on, that we come to our senses, while we still have time to repent and turn to God. It is good to know God and the bishop. Whoever honors the bishop has been honored by God. Whoever does anything behind the bishop's back is serving the devil.

So let everything overflow for you in grace, for you are worthy. You have given me rest in every way; may Jesus Christ give you rest. You loved me when I was away and when I was with you. God is your reward. Enduring all things for his sake, you will reach him.

choices.english: to know God and the bishop

choices.why: λατρεύω is service with a worship tone; 'serving' keeps it plain.

choices.english: May Jesus Christ give you rest
choices.why: Verbless clause; the wish form follows from the context and Ignatius's habit.
rejected: Jesus Christ shall refresh you (ANF; turns wish into promise)

choices.why: The sobriety image is Ignatius's own; kept rather than abstracted to 'reform'.

anf_compare.notes: ANF translates εἰδέναι 'reverence' where the Greek says 'know'; otherwise same sense.

notes: Span: whole of Smyrnaeans 9 (sections 1, 2); old ANF span covers the full chapter.
Pack topic: bishops-presbyters. Same chapter English is shared by every excerpt id on this chapter.
Pack Greek prints 'δἰ' (for δι’); copied as printed. 'For his sake' takes δι’ ὃν with God as antecedent.

Repair 2026-10-02: Pass B now keeps πάντα (no 'gift'), ἄξιοι γάρ ἐστε as 'for you are worthy', τι as 'anything', repentance inside the ὡς ἔτι καιρὸν clause, and ὑπομένοντες as a participle, not a command.

review.notes: Checked paragraph [1] against both passes. Εὔλογόν ἐστιν λοιπὸν ἀνανῆψαι ἡμᾶς, ὡς ἔτι καιρὸν ἔχομεν εἰς θεὸν μετανοεῖν matches A “It is reasonable, from now on, for us to come back to our senses, while we still have time to repent toward God” and B “repent and turn to God” (εἰς kept directional). ὁ τιμῶν ἐπίσκοπον ὑπὸ θεοῦ τετίμηται and ὁ λάθρα ἐπισκόπου τι πράσσων τῷ διαβόλῳ λατρεύει match honor-by-God and “anything behind the bishop's back” / “serves the devil”. πάντα…περισσευέτω, ἄξιοι γάρ ἐστε, κατὰ πάντα με ἀνεπαύσατε, καὶ ὑμᾶς Ἰησοῦς Χριστός (wish “may”), ἀπόντα με καὶ πάροντα, and ἀμοιβὴ ὑμῖν ὁ θεός, δἰ ὃν πάντα ὑπομένοντες αὐτοῦ τεύξεσθε match both passes (participle, not command; δι’+acc. “for his sake”; future “you will reach him”).
